title: Successful Card Details Viewing Flow - Main Menu Launch
description: Test the end-to-end successful workflow for a cardholder viewing card details from the main menu, including privacy guidance, OTP authentication, card detail reveal, and session termination.
testDescription: Validates the complete positive flow for viewing card details as launched from the main menu, including API response handling and regulatory constraints.
prerequisites: User is authenticated, cards are available in account, mobile phone registered, no previous lockouts.
stepsToPerform:
1. Navigate to 'View Card Details' from main menu
2. Initiate card selection screen and select a card
3. Observe privacy/security guidance screen
4. Click 'View Card Details' to proceed
5. Receive OTP code on registered phone
6. Enter correct OTP within valid time window
7. Successfully retrieve card details via API; decrypt and render with correct branding
8. Observe 90-second timer, copy card number, and view front/back/CVV
expectedResult: Card details are displayed for 90 seconds only, all fields are properly masked except during the timer, OTP is validated, correct card image (VISA/MasterCard/Amex/Isracard) is shown, privacy guidance is visible, session ends or timer expiry erases sensitive data according to PCI/PII compliance.
requiredFields: cardNumber, expirationDate, cvv, cardBrand, timer, otpCode, cardholderName, sessionStatus
regulatoryChecks: PCI DSS masking for card number/CVV, GDPR consent and privacy guidance, Israeli banking language/UX compliance
localization: English, Hebrew; text direction and messaging as per channel
cacheChecks: Card details cached for back navigation, erased on timer expiry/session close
sessionConstraints: Timer boundary, session abort, back navigation integrity

title: Error Handling - No Cards Found via API Response
description: Test scenarios where a user attempts to view card details but the backend returns no cards (API returns 203+ID=31 or 204), verifying correct zero-state error screens and action triggers.
testDescription: Ensures that all 'no card' flows from both main menu and post-order lobby are handled as per technical and business requirements.
prerequisites: User is authenticated, account has no cards, API configured to return 203+ID=31 or 204.
stepsToPerform:
1. Launch 'View Card Details' from main menu
2. Backend API returns HTTP 204 or 203+ID=31
3. Observe zero-state screen with correct messaging and illustration
4. Verify display of 'Order new card' or 'Try again' buttons
5. Attempt retry for viewing card details
6. Click to order new card and validate navigation to card order flow
7. Localize messaging (English/Hebrew)
8. Back navigation returns to originating menu
expectedResult: Zero-state error screen shown, buttons trigger expected actions, retry updates data accordingly, all error texts comply with UX/regulatory standards, no PII exposure, session clean on abort.
fieldsTested: errorCode, errorId, cardCount, zeroStateText, retryAction, newCardAction

title: OTP Attempt Boundary and Lockout Handling
description: Validate the system’s handling of OTP entry attempt limits, session lockout, timer expiration, and related error flows, including all negative input edge cases.
testDescription: Tests state transitions for OTP workflow, including incorrect OTP, expired codes, maximum attempt lockout, and unblock flows.
prerequisites: User is authenticated, mobile phone registered, at least one card present, backend supports OTP limit logic.
stepsToPerform:
1. Initiate card details viewing
2. Receive OTP prompt; enter incorrect OTP repeatedly up to boundary (e.g., 5 times)
3. Verify error messages for bad OTP entry
4. On exceeding max attempts, observe lockout popup and timer
5. Try resend code after lockout; verify error for blocked session
6. Wait prescribed timeout (e.g., 10 minutes) and retry
7. Enter correct OTP after unblock
8. Recover and complete workflow if session allowed
expectedResult: System blocks after max attempts, displays proper lockout error message, timer shown for unblock, correct handling of resend/code expiration, clean session on abort, session resumes only after timeout, no card data exposed during lockout.
errorMessaging: Inline text, popup, color rules, guidance compliance
cacheValidation: Ensure no PII/cached card data before OTP success

title: Real-Time API Failure Handling & Data Refresh on Retry
description: Test the integration points for card details retrieval, API responses (including status codes and error IDs), and data refresh/propagation after retry or error flows.
testDescription: Ensures backend API failures are surfaced to the user with clean error handling, retry actions propagate fresh data, and cache is updated/reset.
prerequisites: User authenticated, at least one card present, backend API intermittently configured to return errors (HTTP 500, 403, 203+ID=31/32/33).
stepsToPerform:
1. Select card to view details
2. Backend returns error status (simulate various error codes)
3. Observe error screen/message as per decision table
4. Click 'Try again' to refresh data
5. Backend returns success, card details retrieved and decrypted
6. Verify new card/updated data rendered
7. Verify cache updated for back navigation
8. Abort session and verify cache redaction
expectedResult: Error propagation maps to correct UX screens/messages, retry triggers fresh API call, updated card data shown, cache is properly overwritten, all fields masked as per compliance before/after retry.
apiStatusMapping: Table of HTTP+error ID to displayed error
refreshLogic: Retry actions guarantee fresh data, masking on cache

title: Access Control – Non-Cardholder Attempt and Masking Compliance
description: Validate system behavior when a non-cardholder or unauthorized user attempts to view card details, enforcing strict access rules and PCI masking, with exhaustive error paths.
testDescription: Tests role/permission constraints for card viewing, including real-time account ownership check, masking on unauthorized access, and regulatory error handling.
prerequisites: Non-cardholder or user with mismatched account, cards present in account, backend configured to enforce permission checks.
stepsToPerform:
1. Attempt to view card details as non-cardholder
2. Select card from menu or post-order lobby
3. Observe error messaging from backend (HTTP 203+ID=32 or 204)
4. API returns no cards or access denied
5. Display zero-state error screen
6. Verify masking/redaction of all PII/sensitive fields
7. Attempt retry or navigation to other actions
8. Confirm no data persists in cache or logs
expectedResult: System blocks non-cardholders, all fields masked/redacted, regulatory-compliant error screens shown, retry allowed if permitted, no card details or PII exposed, cache and audit logs clean.
permissionChecks: Role validation per API session, account ownership filtering
maskingControls: PCI/PII full masking, session boundary enforcement

title: Back Navigation from Card Details with Session Cache Redaction
description: Test the workflow when the user navigates back from the card details screen before the timer expires, ensuring proper cache deletion and PCI DSS compliance for sensitive data masking.
testDescription: Validates cache handling and field redaction when the user uses back navigation before 90-second timer expiry after card details are revealed.
prerequisites: User authenticated, cardholder, valid OTP entered, card details successfully displayed, 90-second timer active.
stepsToPerform:
1. Open 'View Card Details' flow from main menu
2. Select a card from multiple cards
3. Proceed through privacy guidance and OTP authentication
4. On card details screen, verify timer starts
5. Before timer expires, click 'Back' navigation
6. Verify user is taken to previous screen
7. Check cache in browser/device memory for card details
8. Ensure sensitive fields (card number, CVV) are masked/redacted
expectedResult: User returns to the prior screen, session cache is fully wiped for card data, no PII or card details remain in memory or storage, PCI DSS masking confirmed, session timer is aborted.

title: Handling Invalid Card Brand Codes in Card Details Rendering
description: Test the scenario where backend returns an unknown or invalid 'brandCode', verifying fallback UI, error messaging, and masking for all card fields.
testDescription: Ensures robust handling of invalid card brand codes during card details display, with appropriate fallback and regulatory-compliant error handling.
prerequisites: User authenticated, at least one card present, backend API configured to return invalid brandCode (not 1,2,3,7), valid OTP entered.
stepsToPerform:
1. Initiate card details view workflow
2. Select a card for viewing
3. Complete OTP authentication successfully
4. Backend returns encrypted card details with invalid brandCode
5. Client attempts to render card details screen
6. Verify fallback to generic branding/image
7. Ensure all card fields are properly masked
8. Display inline error message as per regulatory requirements
expectedResult: Generic card branding is shown, all fields masked, error text matches regulatory requirements and does not expose PII, retry or finish buttons are available.

title: Timer Boundary and Sensitive Data Erasure on Expiry
description: Test the time-bound access scenario for card details display, ensuring sensitive data is erased exactly when the 90-second timer expires and the session closes.
testDescription: Validates timer logic and regulatory-mandated erasure of sensitive card data upon session expiry.
prerequisites: User authenticated, cardholder, valid OTP entered, card details decrypted and displayed, timer visible.
stepsToPerform:
1. Enter card details screen after successful OTP
2. Observe timer starts at 90 seconds
3. Wait for timer to approach expiry (boundary value: 0 seconds)
4. Verify front/back card details are accessible before expiry
5. Copy card number and CVV if allowed
6. Let timer reach zero
7. Observe automatic erasure of sensitive fields
8. Ensure user is redirected to finish or session closed screen
expectedResult: Sensitive card fields (number, CVV, expiration) are erased exactly at timer expiry, all client cache purged, user cannot retrieve/copy card info post-expiry, full PCI/PII regulatory compliance.

title: Multilingual & Directionality Rendering for Privacy and Error Messages
description: Verify that the card details workflow, including privacy/security guidance and error handling, renders in Hebrew (RTL) and English (LTR) with correct formatting, text direction, and messaging per regulatory and UX standards.
testDescription: Ensures all static and dynamic content, guidance, error, and privacy messaging supports English and Hebrew, including RTL/LTR formatting and correct regulatory messaging.

stepsToPerform:
1. Launch 'View Card Details' flow in Hebrew interface
2. Navigate to privacy guidance screen
3. Validate guidance, timer text, error popups in RTL
4. Proceed to card details and observe correct RTL display
5. Switch language to English
6. Repeat workflow and validate all screens in LTR
7. Trigger an error state (e.g., API failure) and observe error message formatting
8. Validate regulatory text in both languages for compliance
expectedResult: All guidance and error messages, timer, privacy alerts, card details appear in correct language, text direction, and formatting; regulatory requirements for localization fully met.

title: Real-Time Card List Update After New Card Order and Account Ownership Filtering
description: Test update of card list after successful new card order, verifying only user-owned cards are shown, real-time update, and filtering per account ownership rule.
testDescription: Ensures card selection screen dynamically reflects new card entries, only cards registered to the user are shown, and filtering logic is correct post-order.

2. Trigger card list refresh via API
3. On card selection screen, observe real-time update
4. Verify only cards with user's account ownership shown
5. Attempt to select non-owned card (should be unavailable)
6. Select newly added card
7. Proceed through privacy guidance to OTP
8. Confirm card details display for newly ordered card
expectedResult: Card list updates in real time, shows only user-owned cards, new card appears after order, selection filtering is enforced, no unauthorized card details are accessible.

title: Copy Card Details - Clipboard & PCI Masking Test
description: Validate copy-to-clipboard functionality for card details within 90-second timer, ensuring PCI-compliant masking before/after timer expiry, clipboard persistence, and regulatory-compliant audit.

stepsToPerform:

3. Validate clipboard value for PCI masking outside timer

8. Attempt to copy after timer, ensure clipboard contains only masked/redacted values
expectedResult: Clipboard contains full card info only during timer, fields masked after expiry, PCI DSS-compliant masking at all stages, clipboard cleared automatically post-session, audit trail available if required.
testedFields: cardNumber, cvv, expirationDate, timer, clipboardStatus, auditLog
maskingRules: PCI mask (first 12 digits masked, 4 visible), CVV masked after expiry
timerBoundaries: Allowed copy within 90 seconds only, post-expiry masking enforced
auditVerification: Audit entry for copy, compliance checked

testDescription: Ensures error handling and user guidance when API returns HttpStatusCode=203 with ID=31 (no mobile), popup shown, process abort enforced, and no data exposure occurs.

errorPopupText: Mobile registration error, guidance for updating via banker
sessionAbortLogic: Clean session, data masking on abort
regulatoryCompliance: Popup messaging matches GDPR, Israeli banking requirements

testDescription: Tests card selection list display, account ownership filter, backend-triggered real-time list refresh post-order, UI reactivity for new cards, and enforcing selection constraints.

filteringLogic: Account ownership per backend response, display update post-order
realTimeUpdate: Card list refresh on backend event

testDescription: Tests session timer, Amex-specific dual-CVV reveal, navigation between front/back views, copy action, timer expiry handling, and PCI rule compliance for CVV masking.

expectedResult: For Amex: both CVV fields appear as per brand rules, timer-controlled reveal for each, copy allowed only during timer, fields masked on expiry, UI navigation to/from CVV screens works, PCI DSS masking validated.

PCICompliance: CVV masked after timer, dual-CVV logic only for Amex

description: Ensure end-of-session finish screen displays correct contextual information, available actions, and regulatory messaging whether triggered by timer expiry or manual completion, covering all channels and error paths.
testDescription: Tests workflow for manual completion and timer-based session finish, verifies 'Done' screen, home/navigation, error recovery flows, and callback actions per UX/regulatory standards.

regulatoryMessaging: Text from backend matched to compliance
callbackActions: Actions for card, order, navigation validated

description: Test the workflow for requesting a voice OTP (instead of SMS), timer control, API invocation, and error coverage for resend scenarios including attempt boundary and lockout paths.
testDescription: Validates resend OTP by voice action, boundary value for resend attempts, correct messaging, timer reset, and lockout handling on excess requests.

expectedResult: Voice OTP is triggered and delivered correctly; the UI renders timer and guidance per API; max resend exceeded results in proper regulatory popup and timer; after timeout, workflow resumes as allowed; no card data exposure at any stage.
boundaryLogic: Resend max attempts, lockout, timeout recovery

title: CVV Expired Code Recovery and New OTP Issue
description: Test negative and recovery scenarios when user enters an expired OTP code, including error rendering, retry flow, and issuance of a new code with session integrity.
testDescription: Ensures user is shown the expired code error (Sc0008), cannot enter new code, and is able to restart the OTP process and receive a new code, with full masking and session compliance.
prerequisites: User authenticated, card present, previously requested OTP, OTP expired by timer or manual test.
stepsToPerform:

2. Wait for OTP code to expire or simulate expiry
3. Enter expired OTP code in input
4. Observe error message and red state per API (HttpStatusCode=203+ID=33)

8. Complete OTP validation and continue to card details if allowed
expectedResult: Expired OTP error shown in red, input field disabled, user prompted with clear regulatory guidance; on process restart, new code is issued and process resumes; masking enforced throughout, session audit clean.

title: Card Selection Screen - Maximum Cards and UI Overflow Handling
description: Test card selection workflow for accounts with a large number of cards, including UI overflow, real-time API update, filtering, branding, and selection controls.
testDescription: Ensures card selection can scale to boundary values (e.g., 20 cards), handles overflow, correct branding image retrieval, only user-owned cards selectable, and error recovery if API update fails.

expectedResult: Card selection list renders up to boundary limit smoothly; branding and ownership filtering is correct for all entries; new cards added update UI without overflow errors, non-owned cards are not selectable; session/caching integrity maintained.
fieldsTested: cardListInfo, cardVendorProductId, cardOwnership, UIoverflow, cacheStatus, APIrefresh

title: Concurrent Session Handling - Multi-Device and Cache Integrity
description: Evaluate system behavior with multiple concurrent sessions (browser/device), checking cache consistency, timer sync, OTP gating, and navigation state for parallel users.
testDescription: Tests edge cases for starting card details view workflow simultaneously on web and app, ensuring session boundaries, timer logic, cache redaction and masking, and regulatory-compliant access handling.
prerequisites: User authenticated on multiple devices, card present, no prior lockouts, session cache enabled, backend supports multi-session tracking.
stepsToPerform:
1. Launch 'View Card Details' on desktop browser
2. Launch same workflow on mobile app (parallel)
3. Proceed through preparation screen on both
4. Initiate OTP authentication; verify codes issued per session
5. Enter correct OTP on one session, leave timer running
6. Try accessing card details on second session, monitor state and error handling
7. Check cache for both devices, verify no cross-session data leaks
8. Abort session on one device, verify masking and timer restrictions apply globally
expectedResult: Each session operates independently: OTP and timer are tracked per device, cache masking is enforced, card details are not accessible across sessions, abort on one device does not expose PII on other, full regulatory cache/session compliance.
concurrencyRules: Session independence, OTP per session, timer sync not allowed
cacheIntegrity: Masking on all aborts, no cross-device leaks
regulatoryChecks: PCI DSS, GDPR, Israeli session/PII handling

testDescription: Ensures that API timeout for card details triggers correct error screens, session masking, and allows safe retry without exposing sensitive data.

expectedResult: Timeout error screen is shown; all PII fields masked; retry action triggers fresh API request; session is clean; card details only displayed on valid API response.
maskingRule: Sensitive fields fully masked during error
sessionAbortPolicy: Session recovery allowed if retry is pressed, session remains clean after abort

title: Card Details API - HTTP Status and Error ID Decision Table Exhaustion
description: Validate all combinations of HTTP status codes and error IDs returned from card details API, ensuring each maps to the correct screen, error message, masking behavior, and retry logic according to the regulatory decision table.
testDescription: Exhaustively tests the decision table for card-channel/web-order/card-account/cards/details and downstream APIs, ensuring every error ID and HTTP status code produces the expected UI state and regulatory-compliant messaging.
prerequisites: User authenticated, backend capable of simulating all relevant HTTP codes (200, 203, 204, 403, 408, 500) and error IDs (31, 32, 33, others), card present or absent depending on status.
stepsToPerform:
1. Launch 'View Card Details' workflow
2. Simulate backend API call with HTTP 203 and error ID=31
3. Verify zero-state screen and regulatory-compliant text
